title: 20 years, 10 regime classifiers, one scoreboard: two thresholds on the VIX beat every statistical model I tested.
author: Just-Pomegranate-952
selftext:
I built a platform that audits regime classifiers. Then I pointed it at my own ten and published the scoreboard. Twenty years of SPY, every classifier at shipped defaults, metrics frozen in a version-controlled registration before the compute ran. Nothing searched, nothing re-run, one shot.

Here is what twenty years says.

Regime detection forecasts volatility, not returns. 

Best return separation on the shelf, stressed days minus calm days, is +1.6pp and several are negative. Volatility separation runs to +15.9pp. It is a risk instrument. Every product that sells it as an alpha signal is selling you a different thing than it says on the box.

The simplest classifier beat every model. 

Two VIX thresholds, 16 and 25, out-forecast every statistical model on the shelf: 15.9pp against 10.8 for the best HMM. The 200-day line took second and won the column that costs money, its stressed days preceding 63-day drawdowns 5.4pp deeper than its calm days. Twenty years of fitted machinery, beaten by two numbers.

The audit caught a dead lane, which is the point. 

My macro classifier at shipped defaults separates nothing: minus 0.4pp on volatility, wrong sign on drawdowns, kappa near zero against all nine others. It is now marked with that finding on a public page with my name on it. That is the standard I hold everything to, including my own shelf, and it is why the other nine numbers are worth reading.

https://preview.redd.it/qi3wotzejpkh1.png?width=1533&format=png&auto=webp&s=f0c17b23b838761daebe9a74c28be487b1ae20be

All ten cash gates lag buy and hold. SPY 11.3%/yr. Best gate 10.6%, and it cut max drawdown from 55% to 25%. Priced honestly, that is cheap insurance, and it is a result you will not find on a vendor page anywhere.

Full scoreboard, crisis timing, agreement matrix, method: [https://quanterlab.com/research/the-regime-atlas-ten-ways-to-read-the-market-twenty-years-one-scoreboard](https://quanterlab.com/research/the-regime-atlas-ten-ways-to-read-the-market-twenty-years-one-scoreboard)

Sealed next: does a vote of all ten beat the best single one, or does averaging kill the timing.
